UNITED STATES DISTRICT COURT FOR THE EASTERN DISTRICT OF VIRGINIA ALEXANDRIA DIVISION

MARVELLE J. BALLENTINE,

Plaintiff,  v.  KATIE HALL, individually; NATIONAL CENTER FOR MISSING & EXPLOITED CHILDREN; META PLATFORMS, INC.; and JOHN/JANE DOES 1–6,

Defendants. ____________________________________/

Case No. 1:26-cv-02331

[PROPOSED] ORDER

This matter is before the Court on Plaintiff’s Rule 201 Request for Judicial Notice (ECF No. ___). Upon consideration of the Request, the Memorandum in Support, and Exhibit A, and under Federal Rule of Evidence 201(b)(2) and (c)(2), it is hereby

ORDERED that the Request is GRANTED; and it is further

ORDERED that the Court takes judicial notice of the following facts:

(a)	A document was filed on August 13, 2026 in Ballentine v. Meta Platforms, Inc., No. 3:26-cv-05939-RFL (N.D. Cal.), and docketed as ECF No. 152;

(b)	ECF No. 152 is titled “Defendants Meta Platforms, Inc., Accenture LLP, Genpact Limited, and TaskUs, Inc.’s Consolidated Motion to Dismiss Plaintiff’s Second Amended Complaint Pursuant to Rule 12(b)(6); Memorandum of Points and Authorities”;

(c)	ECF No. 152 is signed by Michelle L. Visser of Orrick, Herrington & Sutcliffe LLP as “Attorneys for Defendants Meta Platforms, Inc. and Genpact Limited,” by Devin S. Anderson of Kirkland & Ellis LLP as “Attorneys for Defendant Accenture LLP,” and by Kristin C. Christensen of Ogletree, Deakins, Nash, Smoak & Stewart, P.C. as “Attorneys for Defendants TASKUS, INC.”;

(d)	ECF No. 152 contains a footnote numbered 3, beginning at ECF page 11 of 25 and ending at ECF page 12 of 25, whose text is as set forth in Paragraph 4(d) of the Request and at Exhibit A pages 11–12; and

(e)	Footnote 3 of ECF No. 152 identifies this action as “Ballentine v. Katie Hall, et al., No. 1:26-cv-2331 (E.D. Va.)”;

and it is further

ORDERED that judicial notice is taken of the existence, filing date, signatories, and text of ECF No. 152 only, and not of the truth of any statement contained in it.

The Clerk’s Office is directed to provide a copy of this Order to pro se Plaintiff at his last known address.

It is SO ORDERED.

Alexandria, Virginia

__________, 2026

______________________________

Rossie D. Alston, Jr.

United States District Judge
